raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Description

SM90 FlashInfer GDN decode can let CUDA graph padding indices (`-1`) alias the last recurrent-state pool slot. Install the validated padding backport automatically when a supported Qwen GDN model actually selects FlashInfer decode.

Honor SGLang's backend precedence: `linear_attn_decode_backend` overrides `linear_attn_backend`, which defaults to **Triton** in the pinned SGLang and supported SM90 runtimes. Unset decode and explicit Triton no longer trigger the FlashInfer >=0.6.17 guard. A general FlashInfer selection still applies the patch, while a decode-specific Triton/CuteDSL selection overrides it. Unsupported `auto` values are left to native argument validation rather than interpreted as FlashInfer.

Preserve source hash guards, atomic installation, write-free repeated startup and independent opt-in CPU multimodal preprocessing. Integrate latest main and resolve the startup/test conflicts without dropping either path.

## Related Issue

Follow-up to #1806. Addresses [review comment](https://github.com/areal-project/AReaL/pull/1837#discussion_r4420084149).

## Type of Change

- [x] Bug fix

## Validation

- **112 tests passed** in the actor runtime: `tests/test_sglang_model_patches.py`, `tests/test_sglang_gdn_decode_padding.py`, `tests/test_sglang_cuda_graph_config.py`, and `tests/test_sglang_qwen_vl_cpu.py`.
- Regression coverage includes default Triton, explicit general/decode backends, both override directions, old FlashInfer 0.6.7.post3, guarded FlashInfer >=0.6.17, CPU processor opt-in, concurrent/atomic installation and write-free repeats.
- Actual read-only actor SIF (`SGLang 0.5.10.post1`, `FlashInfer 0.6.7.post3`): native defaults were confirmed as general=`triton`, decode=`None`. Default startup, explicit general Triton, and general FlashInfer overridden by decode Triton all completed bootstrap without modifying GDN source.
- Earlier validation of the unchanged kernel backport used the actual SGLang 0.5.19.dev125+g119b5ffe4 / FlashInfer 0.6.17 rollout SIF and a single-SM90 eager/CUDA-graph regression. Padded batch 4 matched unpadded batch 2; unused recurrent-state slots remained unchanged. Full training was not rerun for this review fix.
- Changed-file pre-commit hooks passed. `pre-commit run --all-files` was executed; repository-wide dependency, lock and CLI-doc hooks remain blocked on the submission host by missing `tomllib`, `uv` and `mdformat`. No hooks were bypassed and dependency pins are unchanged.

## Checklist

- [ ] Full pre-commit run passes (environment limits above)
- [x] Relevant tests pass; regressions added for review feedback
- [x] Module documentation updated
- [x] Branch synchronized with latest fetched main
- [ ] Breaking change

## Runtime requirements

Only the affected FlashInfer decode path requires a separately provisioned FlashInfer >=0.6.17 runtime and a validated source profile. Triton decode retains compatibility with the repository's existing pins. Unknown target sources fail before writing. Source installation requires a writable runtime or prepatched image; repeated startup is write-free. Slurm workers use a temporary writable layer, leaving the original SIF unchanged.

An organization owner can choose the repository organization as the billing source for reviews requested by members with a paid Copilot license. [Learn about Copilot code review billing](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/concepts/agents/code-review#code-review-usage).

When `--linear-attn-decode-backend` is omitted, this condition treats `None` as requiring the FlashInfer patch. However, the pinned SGLang `0.5.10.post1` defaults `linear_attn_backend` to `triton` and resolves the decode backend as `linear_attn_decode_backend or linear_attn_backend` ([defaults](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/v0.5.10.post1/python/sglang/srt/server_args.py#L553), [resolution](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/v0.5.10.post1/python/sglang/srt/layers/attention/linear/utils.py#L38)).

Consequently, a Qwen3.5/Qwen3-Next launch using the repository's pinned FlashInfer `0.6.7.post3` now raises `RuntimeError: FlashInfer >= 0.6.17 is required for this patch` before starting SGLang, even though its Triton decode path never invokes the affected FlashInfer kernel. Explicit `--linear-attn-backend triton` also triggers this failure because that argument is not parsed here. The base commit returns without this check for these models, so this breaks previously valid startup configurations independently of the SM90 padding bug.

When `--linear-attn-decode-backend` is omitted, this condition treats `None` as requiring the FlashInfer patch. However, the pinned SGLang `0.5.10.post1` defaults `linear_attn_backend` to `triton` and resolves the decode backend as `linear_attn_decode_backend or linear_attn_backend` ([defaults](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/v0.5.10.post1/python/sglang/srt/server_args.py#L553), [resolution](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/v0.5.10.post1/python/sglang/srt/layers/attention/linear/utils.py#L38)).

Consequently, a Qwen3.5/Qwen3-Next launch using the repository's pinned FlashInfer `0.6.7.post3` now raises `RuntimeError: FlashInfer >= 0.6.17 is required for this patch` before starting SGLang, even though its Triton decode path never invokes the affected FlashInfer kernel. Explicit `--linear-attn-backend triton` also triggers this failure because that argument is not parsed here. The base commit returns without this check for these models, so this breaks previously valid startup configurations independently of the SM90 padding bug.

Fixed in d896bde3. The bootstrap now parses both backend flags and uses decode override → general backend → the pinned/supported SM90 default (Triton). Only an effective `flashinfer` decode applies this patch and checks FlashInfer >=0.6.17; `None` and unsupported `auto` are no longer treated as FlashInfer.

Added regressions for default/explicit Triton, general FlashInfer, both decode-override directions, and FlashInfer 0.6.7.post3 versus 0.6.17. All 112 related tests pass. I also verified the actual read-only SGLang 0.5.10.post1 / FlashInfer 0.6.7.post3 actor image: default Triton, explicit general Triton, and general FlashInfer overridden by decode Triton all complete bootstrap with unchanged GDN source.

Merged current main and preserved its independently selected CPU multimodal processor integration; startup/test conflicts are resolved.
